diskHashChangeExplanation: The persistent-session harness extension changed edit-scenario.cjs on disk while the discovery Node process remained live. Its require-loaded scenario continued using the initial source. Later per-seed hashes describe on-disk files, not a reloaded runner. The only scenario change was waiting for stressLoadSerial > 0 after file input, intended for reused pages. This discovery runner uses a fresh page each seed. The separate persistent run loaded and tested the updated harness.
hashCoverageLimit: The discovery runner records app.js, layout.js, styles.css, index.html, edit-scenario.cjs and visual-observer.cjs, not every application module. The newer persistent runner records the expanded module set.
scope: Retain exact raw logs. Do not claim identical harness disk hashes or expanded module hash coverage for the two-hour discovery run.
